name_zh: 面积边际约束的对应运输
formal_object: Source and target surface areas a_i,b_j>0, equal total mass; correspondence costs c_ij from permitted features; epsilon>0.

operations.input: Counting vertices versus integrating surface area
operations.condition: Areas are computed from released/model meshes, not hidden labels
operations.output: Use physical surface mass instead of vertex density

operations.input: Entropic transport with row and column constraints
operations.condition: Finite costs and compatible positive marginals

derivation_steps.statement: Minimize sum Pi_ij c_ij + epsilon sum Pi_ij(log Pi_ij-1), with Pi1=a and Pi^T1=b.
derivation_steps.justification: The entropy-regularized objective is strictly convex on positive feasible support.

derivation_steps.statement: u=a/(Kv), v=b/(K^T u) enforce the two marginals when converged.
derivation_steps.justification: Alternating positive matrix scaling; log-domain arithmetic and residuals are required.

assumptions: True correspondence does not necessarily preserve model-surface area; this assumption can fail under real stretch or shape error.
Source/target surface samples and legal features must actually be available.
Zero-area elements are removed with a retained mapping, not hidden from evaluation.
Sparse support must admit a feasible transport plan.
method_expression: Use area-marginal entropic assignment, obtain per-source targets from normalized transported mass, and use the same lift as controls.
distinguishing_prediction: Area constraints should prevent many source regions collapsing onto the same favored target; they can hurt when the target mass model is wrong.
falsifier: Reject if balancing consistently harms native motion under realistic area change, or row-only matching plus the same geometric lift is adequate.
closest_alternative: Classical Sinkhorn OT; STAC row-normalized correspondence; Catalyst4D's OT anchors need full collision inspection.
decisive_comparison: Same support/cost/lift: row softmax versus equal-count OT versus area OT; complete native scoring and matched correspondence budget.
operational_delta: The global column mass constraint differs structurally from C05's discrete mode coherence; OT itself is existing work.
feasibility_and_cost: Chunked/sparse matrix scaling; support connectivity and target-mesh extraction remain prerequisites.
algebra_review_basis: Derived entropy KKT signs and both marginal updates; positivity and support caveats retained.
empirical_status: Not implemented in this round; no native method comparison or outcome.
originality_status: Unadjudicated. Classical tools and historical related code are explicitly attributed.
